comparability: Three qualified responses are supported by sustained disciplinary substance, not general coherence. Primary has five dedicated Philosophy courses37.5EC plus political philosophy7.5 and six Economics courses45EC; theories of ethics, agency and emotion interact with micro/macro, public, behavioural and empirical economic analysis. Second has five Politics courses37.5EC and six Economics45EC, plus WesternPhilosophy/Ethics15EC; international relations, EU institutions, conflict, law and historical context alter the organising priority to institutions and political economy. Third has five Philosophy37.5 and five Politics37.5, rights/constitutional/international law and qualitative/social enquiry; economic foundations remain7.5EC, a stated limitation. This third official pairing can recombine existing courses: rejection merely because no unused catalogue remains was invalid. Each pair differs by at least four courses/30EC; the changed disciplinary weights follow distinct questions, not arbitrary padding. None reproduces VU recurring integrated Practice, specialist philosophy-of-science/history sequence, complete methods trajectory, supervised Tutorial or compulsory individual thesis. These gaps remain substantial and explicit, but UCR actual sustained philosophical, political and economic study materially addresses the target rather than replacing its defining objects with adjacent fields.
